name: ridewallah-mobile
description: Android and iOS shells for the Ridewallah customer and rider apps (Capacitor). Each app opens its part of the live site.

scripts.sync: cd customer && npx cap sync && cd ../rider && npx cap sync
scripts.ios:customer: cd customer && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:rider: cd rider && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
